products.name: Electrical Adjustable Desk
products.description:
Transform your workspace with our premium electric height-adjustable desk, designed to enhance your productivity, comfort, and overall well-being. Effortlessly switch between sitting and standing positions at the touch of a button, creating a healthier, more dynamic work environment. Say goodbye to back, neck, and shoulder strain while improving your posture, circulation, and energy throughout the day. Whether you're a remote worker, busy professional, avid gamer, or creative mind, this desk adapts to your lifestyle, providing ergonomic support for today's demands.

Available in four sizes (110x60 cm, 120x60 cm, 140x60 cm, and 140x70 cm), our desk offers a durable and spacious tabletop designed to accommodate your setup. The robust steel frame ensures excellent stability, even at its maximum height range of 70-118 cm, so you can work with confidence. Its whisper-quiet motor system provides smooth, seamless height adjustments for a distraction-free experience, while the modern design fits perfectly in any office or home setup. Created for performance and convenience, this desk empowers you to stay focused and comfortable all day long, whether you're managing work projects, gaming sessions, or multitasking.

**Desk Sizes and Recommendations:**
- **110x60 cm and 120x60 cm:** These compact sizes are ideal for small rooms or workspaces where you need to prioritize space efficiency. Perfect for minimal setups like a single laptop or a 24" monitor with essential accessories.
- **140x60 cm:** A slightly larger option suitable for users who need extra room for a dual monitor setup with adequate accessory space.
- **140x70 cm:** The ultimate choice for professional setups. This size is best for comprehensive workstation needs, including dual or ultra-wide monitors, additional equipment, and maximum comfort. Ideal for professionals, gamers, or anyone looking for an ergonomic powerhouse. 

Choose the size that fits your needs and upgrade your workspace today with a desk built to support your goals.

products.name: Dual-Motor Electric Standing Desk
products.description:
Meet our Monis Original Professional Dual-Motor Standing Desk, developed around the feedback and real-world needs of our customers. After setting up workspaces for remote professionals, developers, designers, and digital nomads, we wanted to create a standing desk that feels noticeably more solid, smooth, and professional than a typical adjustable desk.

The result is a premium dual-motor electric standing desk for rent, built for professionals who spend serious time at their workstation and care about stability, smooth movement, and everyday comfort. The synchronized dual-motor system and 3-stage lifting columns provide fast and controlled height adjustments at up to 36 mm per second, while the heavy-duty construction supports setups weighing up to 120 kg.

This is the desk we recommend when you want your temporary workspace to feel like a high-end permanent office. It is ideal for multi-monitor workstations, desktop computers, speakers, docking stations, studio equipment, and other professional setups where a basic desk simply does not deliver the same experience. The 18 mm scratch-resistant tabletop and generous 70 cm depth provide plenty of room for serious work without making the desk feel crowded.

Available in 120 × 70 cm, 140 × 70 cm, and 160 × 70 cm, each desk comes with a black heavy-duty frame, while tabletop colors may vary depending on availability. Whether you are building a home office, working remotely from a villa, or looking to rent a premium standing desk in Bali, this Monis-developed desk combines the flexibility of rental with the feel of a professional workstation.

I would also add a small label somewhere near the product title or specifications:

Developed by Monis based on customer feedback and real-world remote work setups.

products.name: Ergonomic Office Chair
products.description:
Experience ultimate comfort and support with this ergonomic office chair, designed for professionals, gamers, and remote workers who spend long hours seated. Built with a breathable mesh back, it ensures optimal airflow to keep you cool while providing excellent lumbar support for a healthier sitting posture.

The high-density molded foam seat offers plush yet firm support, maintaining its shape even after extended use. Featuring 4D adjustable armrests, this chair allows you to customize height, width, depth, and angle for perfect arm positioning, reducing strain on your shoulders and wrists.

For added comfort, the adjustable headrest provides neck support, while the height-adjustable lumbar support aligns naturally with your spine, preventing lower back discomfort. The multi-angle reclining backrest with a lock mechanism lets you effortlessly switch from an upright working position to a relaxed recline.

A retractable leg rest extends for moments of relaxation, while smooth 60mm silent casters ensure effortless movement across different surfaces. The reinforced 5-star metal base offers stability and durability, supporting long-term use. With a built-in coat hanger, you can keep your essentials within reach.

This ergonomic office chair is the perfect combination of comfort, functionality, and modern design—ideal for enhancing productivity and well-being in any workspace.

products.name: 24" Full HD Office Monitor A24i 2026
products.description:
The Xiaomi Monitor A24i 2026 is the upgraded evolution of the A24i series, designed for smoother performance, sharper visuals, and modern productivity. Featuring a 23.8-inch Full HD Fast IPS panel with a high 144 Hz refresh rate, it delivers fluid motion, crisp clarity, and wide 178° viewing angles — ideal for remote work, multitasking, content creation, and casual gaming.

With 1920 × 1080 resolution and 99% sRGB color accuracy, the A24i 2026 ensures vibrant, precise colors suitable for design work, video editing, and everyday media consumption. The enhanced 300-nit brightness and 1500:1 contrast ratio provide better depth and visibility in various lighting conditions, making it a reliable all-around display for office setups, home workstations, or rental environments.

The 144 Hz refresh rate significantly improves smoothness during scrolling, gaming, and fast-moving visuals, while the 6 ms response time minimizes motion blur. Built-in Low Blue Light technology reduces eye strain during long work sessions, making it comfortable for extended daily use.

Its minimalist slim design with narrow bezels fits seamlessly into modern workspaces, and the adjustable tilt stand ensures ergonomic comfort. With HDMI 2.0 and DisplayPort 1.4 connectivity, it integrates easily with laptops, desktops, and docking stations. Whether for productivity, gaming, or streaming, the A24i 2026 offers a balanced mix of performance and style.

**NOTE:** To achieve a 144 Hz refresh rate, please include a DP cable with your order and confirm that your device is equipped with a DP connection to link with the screen.

products.name: 27" 4K Multimedia Monitor
products.description:
The 27" 4K Multimedia Monitor is the ultimate display solution for remote workers, businesses, and creative professionals who need a high-quality, versatile screen for daily tasks. With its stunning 4K UHD resolution (3840 x 2160 pixels) and vibrant 100% sRGB and 95% DCI-P3 color accuracy, this monitor delivers crisp, detailed visuals, making it ideal for office work, video conferencing, graphic design, photo and video editing, and multitasking.

Designed to adapt to different work environments, this 27-inch IPS display ensures wide viewing angles and consistent color accuracy, whether you're working on spreadsheets, designing marketing materials, or editing high-resolution content. The low blue light mode and flicker-free technology reduce eye strain, making it comfortable for extended work sessions.

This model comes in two connectivity variants to suit different professional needs. The HDMI version is perfect for those who rely on traditional connections, while the USB-C version offers a single-cable solution for video, data transfer, and power delivery — ideal for mac users looking for a clutter-free workspace. With a sleek, modern design and VESA mount compatibility, this monitor easily integrates into any office setup, whether you're working from home or managing a dynamic business environment.

products.name: 34" 4K Gaming Monitor
products.description: Immerse yourself in a world of ultra-wide, crystal-clear visuals with the new Xiaomi Mi Curved 34" Gaming Monitor. Enjoy the comfort of the 1500R curvature, stunning WQHD clarity, and silky-smooth 180Hz gameplay. With AMD FreeSync for seamless action and vibrant colors across a DCI-P3 95% and sRGB 100% Wide Color Gamut, elevate your gaming and multimedia to new heights with no Visible Flicker Low Blue Light Mode and 1ms response time.

products.name: Smart LED Desk Lamp 1S
products.description:
Bring premium, eye‑friendly lighting to your desk, workstation, or cozy corner with this smart LED desk lamp. With up to 520 lumens brightness and a high Ra 90 color rendering index, it delivers clear, natural‑looking illumination that’s ideal for reading, studying, working, or relaxing — without glare or flicker that can cause eye strain.

Thanks to its textured Fresnel lens, light is distributed evenly and naturally over your workspace. The lamp also features 4 dedicated lighting modes — Focus, Computer, Reading, and Child — so you can adjust the light profile to reduce blue‑light exposure, boost concentration, or enjoy soft, gentle illumination for evening use.

Control the lamp directly via the intuitive Xiaomi Home App, or use voice assistants like Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa, and Apple Siri/HomeKit to switch modes, change brightness, or dim the light hands‑free. A built‑in dial knob lets you manually adjust brightness and color temperature as well. Designed for long life, its LEDs are backed by heat‑control technology, offering up to 25,000 hours of reliable performance.

Minimalist and modern, this desk lamp blends into any setup — the perfect smart lighting solution for homes, offices, creative studios, or even remote working spaces for a affordable price.

products.name: Ergonomic Laptop Stand
products.description: Elevate your workspace with our Ergonomic Laptop Stand, designed for versatility and comfort. This stand is universally compatible with all laptops ranging from 10'' to 17'', including popular models from Apple MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, and Powerbook, to a wide range of devices from Asus, Sony, Dell, Toshiba, Lenovo, and more. Whether you're using a sleek iPad or a sturdy notebook, our stand provides the perfect fit. Crafted for optimal ergonomics, it raises your device to eye level, reducing neck and back strain for a healthier, more comfortable work environment. Its sturdy construction ensures stability for your laptop, making it an essential accessory for both home and office use. Enhance your productivity and comfort with this versatile laptop stand.

products.name: Logitech MX Keyboard
products.description:
The Logitech MX Keys is a high-performance wireless keyboard featuring a full-size layout with a Numpad and arrow keys, ideal for professionals. Its Easy-Switch™ keys allow seamless operation across up to three computers, boasting a reliable wireless range of up to 10 meters, even in congested environments. Compatible with a wide range of operating systems including Windows®, macOS, Linux®, Chrome OS, iPadOS, and Android, it offers versatility for any setup. With up to 5 months of battery life, the MX Keys combines convenience, durability, and advanced functionality for an optimized typing experience. Ensuring your laptop or PC can connect via Bluetooth will allow you a seamless connection setup with the Logitech MX Keys.

**NOTE:** If you rent a Mac Studio or Mac Mini, we strongly recommend choosing an Apple Magic Keyboard to avoid any connectivity issues during setup. The Logitech MX Keyboard will be shipped without a USB pairing dongle (Logi Bolt Receiver).

products.name: Nespresso Essenza Coffee Machine
products.description:
Step into the next generation of espresso convenience with the NESPRESSO Essenza Mini — a sleek, ultra-compact upgrade to the older Inissia M105 model. This modern machine combines space-saving design with barista-grade performance, making it the perfect addition to minimalist kitchens, creative studios, rentals, or remote workstations.

Equipped with a powerful 19-bar high-pressure pump, the Essenza Mini extracts rich, aromatic espresso with perfect crema — every single time. The advanced thermoblock system heats up in under 30 seconds, so your favorite brew is always just a button away. Enjoy two programmable coffee sizes (Espresso & Lungo), all while using less energy thanks to its eco-efficient design.

Compared to the older Inissia M105, the Essenza Mini is quieter, more energy-efficient, and even more compact — making it the better choice for modern homes or on-the-go professionals who don’t want to compromise on coffee quality.

**Important Note:** This machine does not include Nespresso capsules. Make sure to add a capsule set to your order so you’re ready to brew from day one.

products.name: Marshall Woburn III Bluetooth
products.description: The Marshall Woburn II/III Bluetooth speaker combines classic design with modern audio technology, delivering powerful, crystal-clear sound. Featuring iconic Marshall aesthetics, this speaker boasts advanced components that produce deep bass, detailed midrange, and crisp highs. Its wireless Bluetooth connectivity allows for seamless streaming from any device, while its multi-host functionality enables you to easily switch between two Bluetooth devices. The Woburn II also offers customizable sound settings through the Marshall Bluetooth app. Perfect for audiophiles and fans of vintage style, the Marshall Woburn II is the ultimate statement piece that doesn’t compromise on sound quality.
